rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who does something as a hobby rather than professionally.

example.english: They are an amateur photographer who only takes pictures in their spare time.
example.traditional: 佢係業餘攝影師，平時得閒先影相。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jip6 jyu4 sip3 jing2 si1 ping4 si4 dak1 haan4 sin1 jing2 soeng2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for someone who pursues an activity without doing it professionally.

example.english: I'm an amateur; I only have time to study oil painting after work on weekdays.
example.traditional: 我係業餘人士，平日放工後先有時間學油畫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jip6 jyu4 jan4 si6 ping4 jat6 fong3 gung1 hau6 sin1 jau5 si4 gaan1 hok6 jau4 waa2

rows.note: Use this when the work or behaviour looks unprofessional, inexperienced, or clumsy.

example.english: The layout of your report is so messy; it's really amateur.
example.traditional: 你份報告排版咁亂，真係唔專業喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 fan2 bou3 gou3 paai4 baan2 gam3 lyun6 zan1 hai6 m4 zyun1 jip6 wo3

rows.note: Use this for an amateur who lacks expertise or is unqualified in the relevant field.

example.english: Don't let that amateur touch the wiring, or there'll be trouble.
example.traditional: 唔好畀個外行人掂啲電線，出事就大鑊喇。
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 bei2 go3 ngoi6 hong4 jan4 dim3 di1 din6 sin3 ceot1 si6 zau6 daai6 wok6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the amateur is inexperienced or new to the activity.

example.english: I'm an amateur, and this is my first time entering this competition.
example.traditional: 我係新手，今次係第一次參加呢個比賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 san1 sau2 gam1 ci3 hai6 dai6 jat1 ci3 caam1 gaa1 nei1 go3 bei2 coi3
